binary.note: build of commit aa7e14f (the measured tree differed only in test fixture strings in core/src/redaction.rs) (branch wip/1110-int): 0.5.1 plus the keyword-query fallback; /health still reports 0.5.1

dataset.name: locomo
dataset.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (snap-research/locomo LICENSE.txt); non-commercial: used here only to measure retrieval, not redistributed

config.memory_format: one memory per dialog turn: '[<session date>] <speaker> said: <text>'
config.add_metadata: chunk_type=auto_log, importance=log, source=bench.transcript, adapter=bench, session_id=<dataset session>, event_id=<dataset turn id>, sequence=1, total=1
config.project_scope: one project per conversation (LoCoMo) / per question haystack (LongMemEval)

depth_probe_request.purpose: diagnostic only, not used in headline metrics except where labelled @50

config.server_defaults: no env overrides (MEMNEST_* removed); mmr_lambda=0.5, distance_cutoff=0.7, low_relevance_fallback=3

hardware.gpu: none used (CPU-only ONNX inference inside memnest)

performance.latency_note: wall time of one POST /search (n_results=10) from the client, searches issued serially after ingest of that project; includes query embedding
